title: pellaea hirsuta
intro: Pellaea hirsuta, commonly known as Hairy Lip Fern, is a type of fern native to Australia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as demulcent and expectorant properties, which may help soothe and calm irritated tissues. Bioactive constituents of Pellaea hirsuta include saponins and flavonoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
